items.title: FBI Attributes $6 Billion-Plus Binance Hack to North Korea
items.summary: The bureau named TraderTraitor and sought blocks on the laundering trail, while Binance kept Nov.

items.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
items.summary: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

items.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
items.summary: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

items.title: Hackers hijack a dozen DeFi websites, all registered with Name.com, and steal about $138,000
items.summary: All 12 hijacked domains are registered through Name.com, according to registry records accessed by The Block, suggesting a compromise.
